summary.health_score_reason: Overall score not calculated: no fresh CWV, search-account or backlink evidence; unknowns are not zero scores.
top_findings: Static compression and cache headers missing

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 21/21 sitemap URLs return 200 with matching canonical

findings.title: Static responses lack compression and explicit cache policy
findings.description: CSS 246561 bytes and site entry JS 77026 bytes lack Content-Encoding despite Accept-Encoding gzip, br; checked static responses lack Cache-Control.
findings.recommendation: Enable compression on serving host and long-lived cache for hashed assets.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod uses global content save date
findings.description: All 21 dates equal global updatedAt, not per-page significant update.
findings.recommendation: Use truthful per-page update times or omit lastmod.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Server-rendered cases with project images and specific descriptions

findings.title: Demo reviews presented as published clients
findings.description: Home and reviews contain example.com demo profiles; first three demo entries lack demo badge.
findings.recommendation: Hide demo entries and publish verified author/project pairs.

findings.title: Outcome percentages lack supporting context
findings.description: Unique Philosophy and Vladkovsky claim percentage growth without period, baseline or data source.
findings.recommendation: Substantiate results or replace with verifiable delivered scope.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 21 unique titles and descriptions; H1 in initial HTML
All 17 published cases linked from portfolio

findings.title: Services lack dedicated landing pages
findings.description: Three core service offerings appear as cards rather than independently addressable pages. Demand not measured.
findings.recommendation: Validate search demand then create distinct, useful service pages and link relevant cases.

findings.title: Case articles have no links to related cases or live project
findings.description: Article anchors only link home and portfolio; common contact CTA exists in footer.
findings.recommendation: Add validated project URL, role/year, related work and service links.

findings.title: Page-specific structured context can be expanded
findings.description: Only a common Person entity describes pages despite visible breadcrumb navigation.
findings.recommendation: Add accurate BreadcrumbList, stable Person @id/sameAs and optional CreativeWork.

findings.title: Fresh CWV unavailable
findings.description: PageSpeed API returned HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. No current mobile CWV claimed.
findings.recommendation: Obtain fresh mobile lab and field measurements after runtime setup or through configured PSI.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Public content and anchors are server-rendered; public crawling allowed

findings.title: Citability and brand evidence not measured
findings.description: No AI answer-engine citation or brand-presence survey performed.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize verifiable reviews/results; evaluate AI mentions separately if required.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All checked img elements have alt attributes; responsive variants exist; case image content populated

findings.title: Case images do not reserve space and cover is lazy
findings.description: Media images lack width/height and CSS aspect ratio. Browser confirmed unloaded lower images have zero height. CWV impact not measured.
findings.recommendation: Emit intrinsic dimensions and prioritize above-fold cover only.

phases.name: Organic acquisition
items: Check indexing and conversions in webmaster tools

limitations: No authenticated webmaster tools or analytics
No backlink or AI citation survey
